dealSummary: Fusion energy company Commonwealth Fusion Systems secured a $1 billion round.
Antora, an energy storage startup developing thermal batteries, raised a $550 million Series C led by G2 Venture Partners and Eclipse.
K2 Space, a startup developing large satellites for communication and defense, secured a $500 million Series D led by Kleiner Perkins and Iconiq at a $6.8 billion valuation.
Function, which develops a health platform tracking lab results and other tests, raised a $450 million round from General Catalyst.
Simile, the developer of a human behavior simulation model, raised a $200 million Series B led by Greenoaks at a $2 billion valuation.
London-based Inforcer, the developer of software for IT managed service providers, secured a $50 million Series C led by Insight Partners.
Sustainable aviation fuel startup Lydian raised a $43 million Series A led by Breakthrough Energy Ventures.
Dallas-based DataBahn, the developer of an agentic data control platform for businesses, raised a $40 million Series B led by Insight Partners.
LemonEdge, a London-based fund accounting platform for private markets, raised a $21 million Series A led by Blackstone Innovations Investments.
AI Infrastructure Capital, a Swiss provider of capital for the compute layer of AI, secured $16 million in a round led by Valyou.
Intropy, a UK-based AI engine for spare parts businesses, raised $11 million in a round led by Felix Capital.
Zurich-based preventive healthcare startup Ahead Health received $10 million in a round led by 3VC and RTP Global.
